facts.fact: Jordan 搬家的消息让 Sam 难过，他独自在美食广场狂点食物"吃情绪"，趁姐妹俩买纪念品时享受自由。
facts.anchor: If Lily were here, she might accuse Sam of eating his feelings, and he had to admit she might even be right.

facts.fact: 占吊床被英国口音高个男孩挑衅时，在家总是回避霸凌的 Sam 第一次坚持不动（后来对方说只是开玩笑）。
facts.anchor: “No. And I’m not moving.” Sam’s heart was pounding, but he didn’t let on.

facts.fact: 端餐来的女孩 Avery 从订单小票认出 Sam 是科技大亨 Penelope Sprague 的孙子，还称 Penelope 是她的个人英雄。
facts.anchor: “You’re Sam Sprague. And your grandmother is Penelope Sprague, the tech tycoon. She’s, like, my personal hero,” Avery said.

facts.fact: Max 向 Sam 展示 Paradise Platinum Pass：所有景点商店短途都能插队，代价是所有人都恨他们。
facts.anchor: “A Paradise Platinum Pass,” Max explained. “You get to cut the lines at every attraction, shop, and excursion. As an added bonus, everyone here hates you for it.”

facts.fact: Sam 对新朋友撒谎说手机落在房间——他和 Lily 是全年级唯一没有自己手机的孩子，规矩与 Nan 有关但父母从不正面解释。
facts.anchor: “Oh, I left it in my room,” Sam lied.

facts.fact: 爸爸 Elliott 是研究人类行为的定性分析师，拒绝借手机的依据是"手机与儿童抑郁"的研究报告；舅舅 Greg 是与妻子 Suzie 搭档的健身网红。
facts.anchor: He was a qualitative analyst researching human behavior, so a lot of his parenting decisions were based on the latest “concerning reports.”

facts.fact: Sam 用妈妈的"肯定式语言"套出父亲往事：Elliott 在 Sam 这个年纪时父亲去世，之后奶奶埋头工作，几乎不见他们。
facts.anchor: “It was hard. I was your age when my dad died, and afterward your grandmother just threw herself into her work. We rarely ever saw her.”

facts.fact: Jordan 踢椅腿约 Sam 密谈：她的手机出发前被父母没收——因为她曾试图离家出走；她劝 Sam 对新朋友说实话，但 Sam 另有主意不打算说。
facts.anchor: “Because I tried to run away,” Jordan explained.
